name: Commerce Product Variation Radio Widget
description: Provides a themable radio-button widget for the purchased-entity (product variation) field on Drupal Commerce add-to-cart forms, replacing the default select dropdown.
project_description:
Provides a themable radio widget instead of using the traditional select box to select a product variation.

 To Use: 

 
 Edit your order item type's "Add to cart" form display 
 Select "Product variation radio" widget on Purchased entity field 
 Click the Purchased entity field gear icon to configure the widget. This where you can select the display mode that you want to use for the radio button
